newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva sole gainer.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva sole gainer.

text.p: Croatian stocks were stable to lower on a smaller volume on Thursday, with blue chip drugs firm Pliva as the sole gainer.
* Of five active issues, one was up, two flat, two down.
* Pliva gained 300 kuna to 13,300 on volume of 269 shares.
* Biggest decliner was confectioner Kras, down 10 kuna to 400, selling 357 shares.
* Most actively traded was Zagrebacka Banka, flat at 980 kuna, on volume of 2,000 units.
